items.title_zh: 有人赚百倍、有人上车即亏损，智谱市值蒸发超5000亿港元，AI大模型估值逻辑变了？
items.title_en: Zhipu Market Value Plunges Over HK$500B: Has AI Model Valuation Logic Changed?
items.summary_zh: 有人赚百倍、有人上车即亏损，智谱市值蒸发超5000亿港元，AI大模型估值逻辑变了？ 搜狐网
items.summary_en: According to a report from Sohu, there is a sharp divergence in the AI large-model sector: some investors have gained 100x returns while others suffer losses immediately after buying. Zhipu's market value has evaporated by over HK$500 billion, raising questions about whether the valuation logic for AI large models has changed.
items.why_zh: 智谱市值大幅蒸发但有人赚百倍，凸显AI大模型投资的高波动与估值逻辑可能面临重塑。
items.why_en: The massive market value loss of Zhipu amid 100x gains for some highlights the high volatility and potential reshaping of valuation logic in AI large-model investments.

items.title_zh: 基于下一代 Qwen4 架构所构建的多模态 MoE 模型，阿里千问预告明晚开源 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.title_en: Alibaba Qwen Previews Open-Source Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A Multimodal MoE Model Based on Next-Gen Qwen4 Architecture
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，魔搭社区（ModelScope）显示，阿里千问 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 模型将于北京时间 08 月 26 日 23:00 开源。 页面显示，阿里千问将发布 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 和 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 两个版本模型。 据介绍，Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 是 基于下一代 Qwen4 架构所构建的多模态 MoE 模型 。官方称提前发布这些架构上的改进，以便社区能为 即将推出的完整 Qwen4 模型家族 做好准备。 官方暂未公布更多信息，IT之家附链接： https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 相关阅读： 《 阿里开源 Qwen3.8-27B 模型，编程、办公场景表现超越 Qwen3.7-Plus 》 《 阿里开放 Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B 模型权重：2.4T MoE、激活 95B、原生 256K 上下文 》
items.summary_en: Alibaba's Qwen will open-source Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 at 23:00 Beijing time on August 26. Built on the next-generation Qwen4 architecture, it is a multimodal MoE model. The early release aims to prepare the community for the upcoming full Qwen4 family.
items.why_zh: 这是Qwen4架构改进的提前预览，预示阿里千问即将全面升级模型家族，对AI开源生态有重要影响。
items.why_en: This early preview of Qwen4 architecture improvements signals an upcoming major upgrade of Alibaba's Qwen model family, significantly impacting the open-source AI ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 苹果全新 Mac mini 搭载 Apple N1 无线网络芯片，支持 Wi-Fi 7、蓝牙 6、Thread 网络技术
items.title_en: Apple's New Mac mini Features Self-Developed Apple N1 Wireless Chip with Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread Support
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息， 苹果今日正式发布全新 Mac mini 便携式主机 ，搭载全新 M6 芯片与此前已经推出的 M5 Pro 芯片，6999 元起售。 IT之家注意到， 全新 Mac mini 搭载 Apple N1 无线网络芯片 ，支持 Wi-Fi 7、蓝牙 6、Thread 网络技术。同时该机拥有 100/1000/2500BASE-T 多千兆以太网端口 (RJ-45 接头)，可选配 10Gb 以太网端口 (Nbase-T 以太网标准，支持 1Gb、2.5Gb、5Gb 和 10Gb 以太网，使用 RJ-45 接头)。 据官方介绍， N1 芯片是苹果针对 Wi-Fi、蓝牙（Bluetooth）及 Thread 协议打造的自研解决方案 。本质而言，N1 芯片在无线连接领域的定位，相当于苹果 C1 与 C1X 调制解调器在 5G 蜂窝网络连接中的角色。 相关阅读： 《 苹果全新 Mac mini 发布：可选 M6 或 M5 Pro 芯片，6999 元起售 》 《 iPhone 17 系列 / Air 搭载自研 N1 无线联网芯片，苹果高管详解其独特优势 》
items.summary_en: Apple has launched a new Mac mini featuring the M6 or M5 Pro chip, starting at 6,999 yuan. It includes the self-developed Apple N1 wireless chip supporting Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread, along with multi-gigabit Ethernet options. The N1 is Apple's custom solution for wireless connectivity, similar to the C1 modem's role in 5G.
items.why_zh: 苹果在无线连接领域进一步自研化，N1芯片的引入强化了Mac生态的设备互联能力。
items.why_en: Apple's continued self-development in wireless connectivity, with the N1 chip, strengthens ecosystem interoperability for Mac devices.

items.title_zh: 赵长江透露智界 V9 旗舰 MPV 明年可升级 L3，此前已官宣有硬件预埋
items.title_en: Zhijie V9 to Support L3 Upgrade Next Year, Confirms Zhao Changjiang; Deliveries Exceed 20,000 Units
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，华为常务董事、产品投资评审委员会主任、终端 BG 董事长余承东今日发布微博，宣布 智界 V9 累计交付突破 20000 台 ，刷新 50 万级新能源 MPV 最快交付纪录。 余承东还透露， 该车在 7 月高端 MPV 市场零售占有率达到 68% 。 IT之家注意到，有网友询问智界 V9 明年能否升级 L3。智界汽车执行董事及执行副总裁赵长江表示：“ 能。 ” 值得一提的是，赵长江在今年 5 月就透露 智界 V9 是 L3 的硬件预埋 。 去年 12 月 15 日，工业和信息化部正式公布我国首批 L3 级有条件自动驾驶车型准入许可，两款分别适配城市拥堵、高速路段的车型将在北京、重庆指定区域开展上路试点，标志着我国 L3 级自动驾驶从测试阶段迈入商业化应用的关键一步。 长安牌 SC7000AAARBEV 型纯电动轿车：可以实现在交通拥堵环境下高速公路和城市快速路单车道内的自动驾驶功能（最高车速 50km/h），目前该功能仅限在重庆市内环快速路、新内环快速路（高滩岩立交 — 赖家桥立交）及渝都大道（人和立交 — 机场立交）等路段开启。 极狐牌 BJ7001A61NBEV 型纯电动轿车：可以实现高速公路和城市快速路单车道内的自动驾驶功能（最高车速 80km/h），目前该功能仅限在北京市京台高速（大兴区旧宫新桥 — 机场北线高速）、机场北线高速（大渠南桥 —…
items.summary_en: Yu Chengdong announced that Zhijie V9 deliveries have exceeded 20,000 units, setting a record for 500,000-class NEV MPVs, with a 68% retail share in the high-end MPV market in July. Zhao Changjiang confirmed the vehicle can be upgraded to L3 next year, citing hardware pre-installation for L3. China's MIIT has issued the first L3 approval permits, marking a key step for commercialization.
items.why_zh: 智界V9确认可升级L3，意味着高阶自动驾驶功能正在加速落地，并受益于政策准入的推进。
items.why_en: The confirmed L3 upgrade for Zhijie V9 signals accelerated deployment of high-level autonomous driving, supported by policy approvals.

items.title_zh: 中科曙光 2026 年上半年归母净利润 9.71 亿元，同比增长 33.31%
items.title_en: Sugon's H1 2026 Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders Reaches RMB 971M, Up 33.31% YoY

items.summary_en: Sugon reported H1 2026 revenue of RMB 7.466 billion (+27.62% YoY) and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 971 million (+33.31% YoY). Non-GAAP net profit rose 48.45% to RMB 844 million. During the period, the company issued RMB 8 billion convertible bonds listed on the SSE.
items.why_zh: 中科曙光业绩双位数增长且扣非增速更高，显示其AI算力相关主业的盈利能力持续增强。
items.why_en: Sugon's double-digit growth, with non-GAAP net profit growing faster, indicates continued strength in its AI-computing-related core business.

items.title_zh: 苹果推出全新 Mac Studio，可选 M5 Max 或 M5 Ultra 处理器，19999 元起售
items.title_en: Apple Unveils New Mac Studio with M5 Max/M5 Ultra, AI Performance Up to 4.3x Faster, Starting at RMB 19,999
items.summary_zh: 苹果今日正式发布全新 Mac Studio 专业台式机，可选 M5 Max 与全新 M5 Ultra 芯片，为专业工作流带来 AI 性能的重要提升，同时带来更快速的图形处理能力；整机延续了苹果标志性的紧凑设计，可直接放置于用户办公桌上。 苹果表示，如今 Mac Studio 的 AI 性能最高提升至 4.3 倍，存储速度最高提升至 2 倍，图形处理速度最高提升至 1.8 倍，CPU 速度最高提升至 1.3 倍，同时配备更高的内存带宽；Mac Studio 可助力创意工作者、开发者、AI 研究人员、数据科学家等群体突破其技术能力的边界。 全新 Mac Studio 自 8 月 27 日 9:00 起接受预订，正式发售日期为 9 月 22 日。 Mac Studio（搭载 M5 Max 处理器）起售价为 19999 元，教育版售价为 18399 元。 Mac Studio（搭载 M5 Ultra 处理器）起售价为 46999 元人民币，教育版起售价为 43599 元人民币。 （更多版本可前往苹果官网查看） 搭载 M5 Max 的 Mac Studio 具体来看，随着 M5 Max 和 M5 Ultra 的推出，Mac Studio 性能得到显著提升。每个 GPU 核心内置的神经加速器可实现大幅提升的矩阵乘法运算速度。M5 Max 拥有出色的端侧 AI 计算能力，其 AI 性能较前代产品…
items.summary_en: Apple has launched the new Mac Studio, offered with M5 Max or M5 Ultra chips. AI performance is up to 4.3x faster, with up to 1.8x faster graphics, 1.3x faster CPU, and 2x faster storage. Pre-orders start August 27 and availability begins September 22, with pricing starting at RMB 19,999 for M5 Max and RMB 46,999 for M5 Ultra.
items.why_zh: Mac Studio专为专业AI工作流大幅提升性能，显示苹果正持续加码端侧AI算力。
items.why_en: With major AI performance gains, the new Mac Studio underscores Apple's continued push into on-device AI computing power.

items.title_zh: 苹果全新 Mac mini 发布：可选 M6 或 M5 Pro 芯片，6999 元起售
items.title_en: Apple Releases New Mac mini with M6 or M5 Pro Chips, Starting at 6,999 Yuan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，苹果今日正式发布全新 Mac mini 便携式主机，搭载全新 M6 芯片与此前已经推出的 M5 Pro 芯片，通过其标志性的超小型台式机设计带来性能的显著升级及更广泛的适用性。 根据苹果介绍，配备 M6 芯片后，Mac mini 的 AI 性能最高可提升 4 倍，存储速度与图形处理速度提升 2 倍，CPU 性能提升 40%。无论是日常办公任务还是智能体 AI 工作流，Mac mini（搭载 M6 芯片）都能带来十分流畅的体验。 而搭载 M5 Pro 芯片的 Mac mini 则提供更专业的性能，助力用户轻松应对从视频制作到游戏开发等高要求项目，可轻松应对各类商务工作流，无论 Mac mini 是作为主工作站使用，还是用于始终在线的桌面端智能体计算。新款 Mac mini 自 8 月 27 日上午 9:00 起接受预购，正式发售日期为 9 月 22 日。 搭载 M6 芯片的 Mac mini 价格为 6999 元起，教育版售价为 6199 元。具体如下： 16GB 内存 +256GB 存储： 6999 元 16GB 内存 +512GB 存储： 8499 元 16GB 内存 +1TB 存储： 10749 元 （更多版本价格可前往苹果官网查看） 配备 M5 Pro 的 Mac mini 售价 12999 元起（15 核 CPU+16 核 GPU），教育版售…
items.summary_en: Apple today unveiled a new Mac mini, available with either the all-new M6 chip or the previously released M5 Pro chip. The M6 model offers up to 4x faster AI performance, 2x faster storage and graphics, and a 40% CPU boost, while the M5 Pro version targets professional workloads. Pre-orders start August 27, with sales beginning September 22, priced from 6,999 yuan for the M6 and 12,999 yuan for the M5 Pro.
items.why_zh: 新款 Mac mini 以亲民起售价大幅提升 AI 与性能，可能重塑桌面端智能体计算与专业创作设备的市场选择。
items.why_en: The new Mac mini brings a major AI and performance boost at an accessible starting price, potentially reshaping desktop options for AI agents and professional creatives.

items.title_en: AI Cloud Provider Lambda in Talks for $3 Billion Pre-IPO Round
items.summary_zh: AI Cloud Provider Lambda in Talks for $3 Billion Pre-IPO Round Bloomberg.com
items.summary_en: AI cloud provider Lambda is reportedly in talks to raise $3 billion in a pre-IPO round, according to Bloomberg. The deal, still under negotiation, would mark one of the largest private investments in AI cloud infrastructure. Specific investors and valuation terms have not been disclosed.
items.why_zh: Lambda的巨额Pre-IPO融资谈判凸显AI算力基础设施领域的资本热度与市场扩张需求。
items.why_en: Lambda's potential $3B pre-IPO round highlights strong capital appetite for AI compute infrastructure.

items.title_zh: Ropedia推出新一代可穿戴采集设备，加速机器人AI训练数据获取
items.title_en: Ropedia launches next-gen wearable capture device for robotic AI training data
items.summary_zh: 据SiliconANGLE报道，Ropedia发布了新一代可穿戴采集设备，专为机器人AI训练数据而设计。该设备可穿戴在操作者身上，用于采集人体动作与操作数据，为具身智能和机器人模仿学习提供训练素材。目前官方尚未公布详细的技术规格、售价和上市时间。随着机器人行业从规则驱动转向数据驱动，高质量真实世界数据的获取成为关键，此类设备有望降低数据采集门槛并推动机器人AI发展。
items.summary_en: Ropedia launches next-gen wearable capture device for robotic AI training data SiliconANGLE
items.why_zh: 真实世界数据是机器人AI训练的关键，该设备有望降低数据获取门槛。
items.why_en: Real-world data is critical for robotic AI training, and this device could lower the barrier to capturing it.

items.title_zh: 最高主频 5GHz 全球移动端最快，高通下一代骁龙旗舰平台 CPU 技术公开
items.title_en: Qualcomm Unveils Next-Gen Snapdragon Flagship CPU Tech: Oryon Hits 5GHz, Claims World's Fastest Mobile CPU
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，高通今晚更新官方博客，针对全新骁龙 8 系旗舰移动平台进行预热，分享了系列重要的新平台 CPU 技术更新。这也是 2026 骁龙峰会前，高通针对全新骁龙 8 系旗舰移动平台预热解读系列内容的第一篇，后续还会发布更多内容。 根据博客内容， 全新一代 Qualcomm Oryon CPU 最高主频达到 5GHz ，成为首个迈过这道门槛的移动 CPU，同时引入了名为 FlexCache 的全新缓存架构。 全新 Oryon CPU 被高通称为“全球最快的移动 CPU” ，支撑这个说法的核心，一是突破性的 5GHz 主频，二是全新的缓存架构。高通在博客里明确写道，达到如此极致的最高主频，仅依靠制程工艺是难以实现的。全新 Oryon CPU 是一颗完全定制的 CPU，每一项微架构特性都由高通自主调校，每个核心还拥有自己的时钟域，可以独立进行频率扩展。 值得一提的是，这套设计思路与主频达到 5GHz 的骁龙 X2 系列一脉相承，如今在移动平台上落地。 时钟速度并不是实现卓越 CPU 性能的唯一因素。该频率与出色的 IPC 相结合，使性能优势在实际应用场景中得以充分体现。例如，App 在用户轻触的瞬间即可打开、网页体验更加流畅，而像游戏、内容创作等高负载任务也能紧跟用户操作和需求。对于智能体 AI 而言，CPU 承担着协调和调度每一次 AI 请求背后复杂计算任务的关…
items.summary_en: Qualcomm has revealed details of its next-generation Snapdragon 8-series flagship mobile platform, featuring a new Oryon CPU reaching 5GHz, the first mobile CPU to do so. The custom-designed CPU includes a new FlexCache architecture and per-core clock domains, delivering what Qualcomm calls the world's fastest mobile CPU. The design builds on the Snapdragon X2 lineup and aims to improve app launch, web browsing, and AI agent performance.
items.why_zh: 这是移动端CPU性能的重要飞跃，5GHz主频与定制架构将深刻影响旗舰手机和端侧AI体验。
items.why_en: This marks a major leap in mobile CPU performance, with 5GHz and custom architecture set to shape flagship phones and on-device AI experiences.

items.title_zh: 汤森路透推出自研AI模型，以减少对Anthropic的依赖并降低成本
items.title_en: Thomson Reuters launches in-house AI model to cut Anthropic costs
items.summary_zh: 据Quartz报道，汤森路透推出了自研AI模型，旨在降低对Anthropic的依赖和相关成本。此前该公司依赖Anthropic的模型来支撑其AI服务，通过开发内部模型，汤森路透得以更好地控制技术栈和成本结构。这一举措反映了大型企业在AI能力上追求自主可控的普遍趋势。目前关于该模型的具体性能、适用范围和部署情况尚未披露更多细节，但预计将逐步替代部分外部模型调用。
items.summary_en: Thomson Reuters launches in-house AI model to cut Anthropic costs qz.com
items.why_zh: 企业自研模型将减少对外部AI供应商的依赖，可能重塑AI服务市场的竞争格局。
items.why_en: In-house models reduce dependence on external AI providers and could reshape the competitive landscape of AI services.

items.title_zh: 消息称赛豆 AIVA 或将采用宁德时代换电方案，首款车型 ME7 年内亮相
items.title_en: Report: AIVA to Use CATL Battery-Swap Solution, Debut Model ME7 to Launch This Year
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，据晚点 Auto 消息， 赛豆科技 AIVA 品牌或将采用宁德时代的换电方案 。知情人士透露，“AIVA 品牌与宁德在探讨换电模式，具体还在进一步规划中。” 另外， 首款量产车 AIVA ME7 计划年内亮相 ，预计明年初开启预定，未来将面向国内及海外市场销售。目前，赛豆科技位于重庆光环商圈的首家旗舰店正在建设中。 IT之家注：赛豆科技前身为重庆蓝电科技，今年完成约 66.71 亿元增资扩股，重庆地方国资成为第一大股东，赛力斯为第二大股东，宁德时代也通过旗下投资平台参与其中。 据官方介绍，AIVA 将是多方产业资源协同下形成的“新范式”，AIVA 品牌作为独立运营主体，负责品牌、产品与业务推进。 赛力斯 作为重要股东方和产业资源方，在整车制造、供应链、质量体系与工程经验等方面提供支持； 宁德时代 在电池技术、电池安全、动力电池充换电体系等方面提供系统的能源解决方案； 国资平台 提供产业资源支持； 火山引擎 为 AIVA 品牌提供豆包大模型、智能座舱等技术服务，帮助 AIVA 品牌提升 AI 汽车交互体验。 在 6 月 9 日举行的赛豆科技品牌发布会上 ，赛豆发布了 AIVA 首款概念车 AIVA Origin Concept， 并宣布首款量产车型 AIVA ME7 将于年内发布 ，全系车型将覆盖 20 万元以上主流市场。
items.summary_en: According to LatePost Auto, AIVA, a brand under Saidou Technology, is in talks with CATL to adopt its battery-swap solution, with detailed plans still under discussion. The first production model, AIVA ME7, is set to debut this year and open pre-orders early next year, targeting domestic and overseas markets. Saidou Technology, formerly Chongqing Landian Technology, has CATL as an investor, with Seres and local state capital also involved. AIVA's lineup will cover the market above 200,000 yuan, leveraging support from Seres, CATL, and Volcano Engine's AI technology.
items.why_zh: 若宁德时代换电方案落地，将影响电动汽车补能生态，也体现AI汽车品牌与电池巨头的深度绑定。
items.why_en: Adopting CATL's battery-swap solution could reshape EV energy replenishment and highlights deep ties between an AI car brand and a battery giant.

items.title_zh: Fanplayr推出目录智能产品，将产品目录转化为AI就绪的产品智能
items.title_en: Fanplayr Launches Catalog Intelligence, Transforming Product Catalogs into AI-Ready Product Intelligence
items.summary_zh: 据Business Wire报道，Fanplayr宣布推出名为Catalog Intelligence（目录智能）的全新产品，旨在将传统产品目录转化为AI就绪的产品智能。该解决方案预计能帮助企业更高效地利用AI分析和激活产品数据，从而优化营销和销售策略，提升运营效率。目前关于该产品的具体功能模块、技术架构和客户案例尚未披露更多细节。这一发布反映了电商与营销领域对AI驱动数据智能的需求持续增长。
items.summary_en: Fanplayr Launches Catalog Intelligence, Transforming Product Catalogs into AI-Ready Product Intelligence Business Wire
items.why_zh: 该产品将产品数据标准化为AI可用格式，有助于企业在AI时代释放数据价值。
items.why_en: It standardizes product data for AI use, helping businesses unlock value from their catalogs in the AI era.

items.title_zh: OpenAI启动“AI Futures”项目，推动全球治理研究
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches AI Futures for Global Governance Research
items.summary_zh: 据AI Magazine报道，OpenAI宣布启动名为“AI Futures”的全球治理研究项目。该项目旨在围绕人工智能的全球治理开展系统性研究，可能涉及政策制定、安全规范、伦理框架等关键议题。目前具体的研究方向、合作机构及产出形式尚未公布。这一举措显示出OpenAI在推动AI安全与负责任发展方面的持续投入，也呼应了国际社会对AI治理日益增长的关注。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches AI Futures for Global Governance Research AI Magazine
items.why_zh: 全球AI治理是当前重大议题，OpenAI的参与可能影响未来政策走向。
items.why_en: Global AI governance is a critical issue, and OpenAI's involvement could influence future policy directions.

items.summary_en: BOSS Zhipin reported H1 FY2026 revenue of RMB 4.467 billion, up 11% YoY, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.102 billion, up 150.8% YoY. Average monthly active users reached 65.5 million, up 8.1%, with mobile MAU surpassing 70 million in Q2. The company declared an annual dividend of approximately RMB 230 million. Adjusted net profit rose 10.6% to RMB 1.885 billion.
items.why_zh: BOSS直聘利润大幅增长且用户规模创新高，显示其盈利能力和市场地位持续增强。
items.why_en: Strong profit growth and record user numbers underline BOSS Zhipin's improving profitability and market leadership.

The online-exclusive LAVIE Direct N15 Slim features Intel Core 3rd-gen 'Wildcat Lake', Wi-Fi 7, and a 15.3-inch screen. Two all-in-one models, LAVIE A27/A23, come with Core i5-1335U and FHD displays.
items.why_zh: 新品搭载AMD锐龙AI处理器和Wi-Fi 7，体现NECPC对AI PC与高速连接规格的跟进，丰富消费级电脑市场选择。

items.title_zh: 欧菲光 2026 年上半年归母亏损 4.44 亿元，同比下降 307.36%

items.summary_en: O-Film reported H1 2026 revenue of RMB 7.841 billion, down 20.29% YoY, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 444 million, widening 307.36% YoY. Operating cash flow rose 113.6% to RMB 694 million. The company cancelled underperforming equity options and is proceeding with the acquisition of O-Film Microelectronics.
items.why_zh: 欧菲光由盈转亏且亏损扩大，折射出消费电子供应链公司面临的需求疲软与转型阵痛。
items.why_en: O-Film's swing to a deep loss highlights weak demand and restructuring challenges in the consumer electronics supply chain.

items.title_zh: 美总检察长对OpenAI及Sam Altman展开大规模AI数据泄露调查
items.title_en: AG Marshall launches investigation into OpenAI and founder Sam Altman for massive artificial intelligence data breach
items.summary_zh: 据报道，美国总检察长（AG Marshall）已启动对OpenAI及其创始人Sam Altman的调查，事由是一起大规模人工智能数据泄露事件。调查目前仍处于早期阶段，具体泄露范围、受影响用户和指控细节尚未对外披露。这起调查可能聚焦于OpenAI的数据安全措施和隐私保护义务。若调查深入，或将对AI企业的数据治理提出更高要求，并可能影响整个行业的合规标准。
items.summary_en: AG Marshall launches investigation into OpenAI and founder Sam Altman for massive artificial intelligence data breach 1819 News
items.why_zh: 针对OpenAI的数据泄露调查可能成为AI监管的标志性事件，倒逼行业提升数据安全标准。
items.why_en: The investigation into OpenAI could set a regulatory precedent for AI data security and privacy compliance.

items.summary_en: Zhipu's shares have swung violently, with some early investors gaining 100x while latecomers suffer losses, and its market value has dropped over HK$500 billion. The article questions whether AI model valuations are shifting from hype to fundamentals.

items.title_zh: 消息称马云出手增持，已连日买入阿里港股超 6 亿港元
items.title_en: Report: Jack Ma Buys Over HK$600M in Alibaba Shares to Back AI Bet
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，据科创板日报，消息人士透露，随着阿里发起配售融资，阿里巴巴创始人马云连日增持阿里港股， 总额已超 6 亿港元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 5.16 亿元人民币） ，表达对阿里 AI 前景的坚定看好。 8 月 23 日， 阿里巴巴宣布拟向美国境外的非美国人士配售新股 ， 配售总金额为 800 亿港元 （现汇率约合 687.92 亿元人民币） 。这也是阿里巴巴 2019 年港股上市以来首次启动新股配售。据悉本次配售所得款项净额 将 100% 用于投资全栈 AI 能力 ，加强 AI 基础设施建设。 8 月 24 日，阿里巴巴集团主席蔡崇信、CEO 吴泳铭出手 增持合计约 1.2 亿港元阿里股票 ： 蔡崇信买入 72 万股阿里巴巴港股，均价约 112 港元，耗资约 8,000 万港元； 吴泳铭买入 35 万股阿里巴巴港股，均价约 111.6 港元，耗资约 4,000 万港元。 8 月 25 日，据港交所信息，阿里巴巴集团主席蔡崇信再次增持约 8,200 万港元阿里巴巴股票。这是阿里新股配售后，蔡崇信个人连续第二个交易日出手， 两日累计增持金额已达 1.6 亿港元 （现汇率约合 1.38 亿元人民币） 。
items.summary_en: Alibaba founder Jack Ma has reportedly bought over HK$600 million of Alibaba shares in recent days, showing confidence in the company's AI prospects. This follows Alibaba's first share placement since its 2019 Hong Kong listing, raising HK$80 billion, with net proceeds fully earmarked for full-stack AI investment. Chairman Joe Tsai and CEO Eddie Wu also increased their holdings, with Tsai adding shares on consecutive days for a total of HK$160 million.
items.why_zh: 创始人及核心管理层在配售融资后连续增持，向市场传递出对阿里巴巴AI战略和未来前景的强烈信心，具有提振投资者情绪的积极意义。
items.why_en: The consecutive share purchases by the founder and top executives signal strong internal confidence in Alibaba's AI strategy and future, which could boost market sentiment.

items.summary_en: According to Cailianshe's morning briefing, Huawei has published a V2 version of the 'Tao's Law' paper, while Doubao and Qwen announced that their agent features will be taken offline. Details about the paper and the reason for disabling agent features remain undisclosed.

items.title_zh: 马斯克首次向 Cursor 全员讲话曝光：称 Grok 已经落后，而他“不习惯失败”
items.title_en: Musk's First Address to Cursor Staff: Admits Grok Lags Behind, Says He's 'Not Used to Losing'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，当地时间 8 月 14 日，SpaceX 宣布完成了对 AI 编程初创公司 Cursor 的 600 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 4,043.23 亿元人民币） 收购。 据 The Information 报道，就在官宣当天，埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）通过视频连线接入了 Cursor 的员工全员大会。 五位知情人士透露，马斯克在会上向员工坦言， S paceX 的人工智能部门已经落后于竞争对手，而他“不习惯失败” 。马斯克表示，与在各自行业处于绝对主导地位的特斯拉和 SpaceX 不同，SpaceXAI 旗下的 Grok 在其所处的市场中尚未取得领先地位，当前迫切需要迎头赶上。 知情人士透露，马斯克在会议中指出，人工智能模型在未来必然会发展到人类无法掌控的超高水平。正因如此，他向聚集在 Cursor 旧金山总部及各分部办公室的员工强调，他们必须协助 SpaceX 的 AI 部门， 赶在其他竞争对手之前攻克并构建出这项技术 。 一位与会人士称，马斯克对 Anthropic 在 AI 竞速中的领先地位表示赞赏，并承认其为一个强劲的对手。另有两位知情人士表示，马斯克还称 SpaceX 将在算力储备上持续发力，保持全行业最高的算力规模。
items.summary_en: According to The Information, on the day SpaceX closed its $60 billion acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor, Elon Musk joined the company's all-hands meeting. Musk admitted that SpaceX's AI division, Grok, has fallen behind rivals and said he is "not used to losing." He urged Cursor employees to help SpaceX's AI team catch up and build advanced AI before competitors, praised Anthropic as a strong rival, and pledged to maintain the industry's largest computing capacity.
items.why_zh: 马斯克罕见承认Grok落后，或预示X和SpaceX将全力加码AI追赶，并进一步整合Cursor人才与算力。
items.why_en: Musk's rare admission that Grok lags behind signals a significant push to catch up in AI, leveraging Cursor's talent and massive compute.

items.title_zh: Tempo发布Workforce Intelligence，将AI支出与Jira工作项关联

items.summary_en: Tempo launches Workforce Intelligence to tie AI spend to Jira work items SiliconANGLE
items.why_zh: AI支出透明度成为企业刚需，Tempo将成本追踪嵌入开发流程，可提升AI投入的效率管理。
items.why_en: As AI spend grows, tying costs to work items offers enterprises crucial visibility and control, making Tempo's move strategically significant.

items.title_zh: 工信部：今年上半年数字产业收入超 20 万亿元，同比增长 13.6%
items.title_en: MIIT: H1 Digital Industry Revenue Exceeds 20 Trillion Yuan, Up 13.6% YoY

items.summary_en: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology reported that digital industry revenue reached 20.71 trillion yuan in H1 2026, up 13.6% YoY. Total profit hit 1.79 trillion yuan, up 19.3%, with a profit margin of 8.6%. Top 10 provinces contributed 83.1% of revenue, while central China grew faster at 28.3% YoY.
items.why_zh: 数字产业收入和利润双高增长，印证AI等需求对经济的拉动，中部崛起值得关注。
items.why_en: Strong growth in China's digital industry highlights AI's economic impact and the emergence of central regions.

items.title_zh: 保时捷与印度塔塔咨询签署为期 5 年、价值 12.5 亿欧元的 AI 合作协议
items.title_en: Porsche signs €1.25 billion AI deal with India's TCS over 5 years
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，据 CNBC 报道，保时捷已与印度最大的 IT 服务企业塔塔咨询服务公司（TCS）签署了一项 为期五年、价值 12.5 亿欧元 （现汇率约合 98.19 亿元人民币） 的人工智能合作协议。 保时捷董事长迈克尔 · 莱特斯（Michael Leiters）表示，此举将把保时捷的“汽车行业专长与 TCS 的数字化及 AI 技术实力深度融合”。面对“日益以数据和软件为核心的未来出行变革”，这一合作将全面提升这家欧洲跑车制造商的创新能力、运营效率与市场竞争力。 TCS 首席执行官 K· 克里蒂瓦桑（K. Krithivasan）表示，借助此次收购，TCS 旨在“ 为保时捷实现规模化、工业级的 AI 技术落地” 。 此外，根据官方公告，作为该交易的一部分，TCS 将出资 3.2 亿欧元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 25.14 亿元人民币） 收购保时捷旗下的 IT 咨询业务 MHP。 出售 MHP 是保时捷“跑车工坊 35”转型战略的一环，该战略旨在提升这家车企的盈利水平与现金流状况。保时捷董事长莱特斯上月曾表示：“ 我们正在坚定地将公司重心全面聚焦于核心业务 。”他同时补充道，该战略的核心举措在于全面精简各个层级的运营流程。
items.summary_en: Porsche has signed a five-year AI partnership worth €1.25 billion with India's TCS. As part of the deal, TCS will acquire Porsche's IT consulting unit MHP for €320 million. The collaboration aims to combine Porsche's automotive expertise with TCS's digital and AI capabilities to drive innovation and competitiveness.
items.why_zh: 全球豪华车企与IT巨头深度绑定AI，标志着汽车行业以数据和软件为核心的转型全面提速。
items.why_en: The deep AI partnership between Porsche and TCS signals accelerating digital transformation in the automotive industry.

items.title_zh: Anthropic推出企业托管认证，保护MCP连接器安全
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Enterprise-Managed Auth to Secure MCP Connectors
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 近日发布了面向企业的托管认证（Enterprise-Managed Auth）功能，用于保护MCP（Model Context Protocol）连接器的安全。该功能可以帮助企业在统一策略下管理AI集成中的身份验证与访问控制，降低安全风险。随着企业越来越多地通过MCP连接外部工具和数据，安全防护成为规模化部署的关键前提。Anthropic此举补足了MCP生态在企业级场景下的安全管理能力，有望推动更多客户放心采用其AI解决方案。这也是Anthropic在企业级AI市场持续加码的又一信号。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Enterprise-Managed Auth to Secure MCP Connectors cyberpress.org
items.why_zh: 企业级安全能力是AI连接器普及的关键，Anthropic以此扫清部署障碍。
items.why_en: Enterprise-grade security is critical for AI connector adoption, and this move removes a key barrier.

items.title_zh: 印度初创公司 Airbound 开发“火箭形态”配送无人机，还要和卡车比货运成本
items.title_en: Indian startup Airbound raises $37M for rocket-style delivery drones
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，据外媒 TechCrunch 今天（25 日）报道，印度自主飞行无人机初创公司 Airbound 完成了 3,700 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2.49 亿元人民币） A 轮融资，希望最终把无人机空运货物的成本 降到与公路卡车运输相当的水平 。 Airbound 不到一年前刚刚获得 865 万美元 （现汇率约合 5,829 万元人民币） 种子轮融资，本轮完成后，这家成立 3 年的公司累计融资已 接近 5,000 万美元 （现汇率约合 3.37 亿元人民币） 。 Airbound 等初创公司认为，相比公路车辆，无人机运送部分货物速度更快、成本更低。无人机配送已经出现了一些成功案例，但无论运输规模还是适用范围，目前都远不能与卡车运输相比。 Airbound 希望从飞行器本身入手缩小差距，让无人机拥有与地面运输竞争的成本优势。 传统飞行器很大一部分能源都消耗在承载自身重量上，而不是运输货物，因此空运成本居高不下，运输小批量货物时尤其明显。 Airbound 创始人兼 CEO 纳曼 · 普什普解释，公司希望制造 自身重量低于所载货物重量 的垂直飞行无人机，以解决这一问题。目前其打造的 TRT 无人机 重约 1.5kg，可以运载约 1kg 货物 ，正在开发的下一代产品预计重约 3kg，载重量最高可达约 5kg。 Airbound 采用 类似火箭的尾座式…
items.summary_en: Airbound, an Indian autonomous-drone startup, raised $37 million in Series A funding to make drone freight cost-competitive with road transport. Its TRT drone weighs 1.5kg and carries 1kg; the next-gen model will weigh ~3kg and carry up to 5kg. Total funding is nearly $50 million.
items.why_zh: 若无人机货运成本能与卡车持平，将颠覆短途物流格局，尤其适合印度等基础设施欠发达地区。
items.why_en: If drone shipping costs match trucking, it could transform logistics in regions with poor road infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 古尔曼：新一代苹果 iPad mini 最晚 10 月下旬发布，带来 OLED 屏幕、防水等升级
items.title_en: Gurman: Next-gen iPad mini to launch by late October with OLED, waterproofing
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，据彭博社记者马克 · 古尔曼今日发文，苹果计划于今年 10 月底之前推出新款 iPad mini 平板， 最大的升级要点便是 OLED 屏幕 。 IT之家了解到，苹果前年已经为 iPad Pro 产品线更新 OLED 屏幕，但 iPad mini、iPad Air 和数字款 iPad 仍然采用 LCD 屏幕。新一代 iPad mini 采用 OLED 屏幕后，色彩将会更加鲜艳、对比度更高，显示黑色时也会更加通透，有望提供更出色的观影体验。 鉴于 OLED 面板的成本价格通常比 LCD 面板更高，同时内存危机还在蔓延，下一代 iPad mini 的起售价可能会高于现款机型。 此外，这款平板预计还将配备全新扬声器系统，整机有望支持防水。 新一代 iPad mini 预计还将搭载 A19 Pro 或 A20 芯片 ，相比当前机型的 A17 Pro 提升显著。
items.summary_en: Apple plans to release a new iPad mini by late October, featuring an OLED display for better color and contrast. It may also get new speakers, water resistance, and an A19 Pro or A20 chip. The starting price could rise due to higher OLED costs and the memory crisis.

items.why_en: The iPad mini's move to OLED marks a major display upgrade for Apple's smaller tablet, potentially reshaping the mid-size tablet market.

items.title_en: Intel Details Wildcat Lake Processor: Up to 40 TOPS AI, UCIe Multi-Chip Packaging
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，科技媒体 Wccftech 昨日（8 月 24 日）发布博文， 报道称英特尔披露了 Wildcat Lake（酷睿 Series 3）系列处理器的相关细节。 定位方面，英特尔 Wildcat Lake 主要面向入门级 PC，保留 Panther Lake 的基础架构，并通过封装、Die 面积、I/O 配置和优化主板设计降低平台成本。 性能方面，Wildcat Lake 最高提供 40 TOPS 的平台 AI 算力，最高可达到 Raptor Lake U Refresh（酷睿 100 系列）的 2.7 倍；创作与生产力性能最高提升 2.1 倍，处理器功耗降低 64%。 封装方案上，英特尔为降低封装成本和良率损失，Wildcat Lake 没有沿用 Panther Lake（酷睿 Ultra Series 3）的 Foveros 方案，改为使用有机多芯片封装（Multi-Chip Package，MCP）和 UCIe（Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express）方案。 其中有机多芯片封装是一种将多个功能不同的裸芯片（Die）垂直堆叠或水平排列，共同封装在同一个有机基质载板（Organic Substrate）上的先进封装技术。 而 UCIe 是半导体行业内的一个开源、标准化的芯粒（Chiplet）互连规范，定义了同一个封…
items.summary_en: Intel detailed its Wildcat Lake (Core Series 3) processors for entry-level PCs, offering up to 40 TOPS of AI performance, 2.7x that of Raptor Lake U Refresh. It uses organic multi-chip packaging with UCIe interconnect instead of Foveros to reduce costs and improve yields.
items.why_zh: Wildcat Lake展示了英特尔在低成本AI PC处理器上的探索，通过新的封装技术平衡性能与成本。
items.why_en: Wildcat Lake shows Intel's strategy to deliver AI-capable processors for affordable PCs using cost-effective packaging innovations.

items.title_zh: 美军测试 Sandhills 2.0：福特 F-250 搭载 Edda 炮塔，可拦截 10~100 米内无人机
items.title_en: US Army Tests Sandhills 2.0: Ford F-250 With Edda Turret to Intercept Drones at 10-100 Meters
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，科技媒体 Tom's Hardware 昨日（8 月 24 日）发布博文，报道称美国陆军已于 8 月 18 日在布拉格堡举行实弹演习， 测试“桑德希尔斯 2.0”（Project Sandhills 2.0）项目。 该项目改造福特 F-250 自动驾驶皮卡，配备 Forterra AutoDrive 自动驾驶系统，以及装配由美国得州奥斯汀企业 9 Mothers 制造的 Edda 反无人机炮塔，通过结合自动驾驶和反无人机系统能力，减少士兵在突破行动中的暴露风险。 9 Mothers 公布的资料称，Edda 是一款“超高速、超轻量、超高精度”的运动平台，可在 15 毫秒内转动 5°，角度精度达到 1.5 角分。 Edda 炮塔面向快速移动的无人机目标，可拦截直径 7 英寸 （IT之家注：约 17.8 厘米） 及以上、距离 10 至 100 米（33 至 328 英尺）的无人机。消息来源称，炮塔重量约 23 千克（50 磅）。系统会先通过声学方式探测来袭无人机，再由车载视觉跟踪系统锁定目标。
items.summary_en: The US Army tested Project Sandhills 2.0 at Fort Bragg on August 18, using a Ford F-250 autonomous pickup equipped with Forterra AutoDrive and 9 Mothers' Edda anti-drone turret. The Edda turret can rotate 5° in 15 ms with 1.5 arc-minute accuracy, intercepting drones 10-100 m away and at least 7 inches in diameter. This aims to reduce soldier exposure during breach operations.
items.why_zh: 这一测试标志着自动驾驶与反无人机系统在军事场景中的整合，有助于提升突破行动中的士兵安全性。
items.why_en: This test marks the integration of autonomous driving and counter-drone systems in military operations, potentially enhancing soldier safety during breaches.

items.title_zh: 中国 AI 为什么追得这么快？美媒找到一批关键人物
items.title_en: WSJ: China's AI Catch-Up Driven by Talent Networks, Open Source, and Compute Efficiency
items.summary_zh: 8 月 25 日，据《华尔街日报》报道，中国 AI 模型近年来快速缩小与美国头部模型的差距，其背后并非短期突然出现的技术突破，而是清华大学等高校长期形成的人才网络，以及开源技术、人才回流和更高算力效率等因素共同推动的结果。报道认为，以智谱 AI 联合创始人唐杰、月之暗面创始人杨植麟以及 DeepSeek 创始人梁文锋等人为代表的一批研究者，构成了中国这一轮 AI 追赶的重要力量。 《华尔街日报》称，中美两国多名行业人士认为，中国最好的 AI 模型目前与美国最先进模型的能力差距已经缩小至数月。今年 6 月，马斯克曾预测中国要到 2027 年第一季度才能追上 Anthropic 的顶级模型，唐杰随后回应称，“不会需要那么久”。 报道将中国 AI 人才体系的形成追溯至 20 多年前。2005 年，图灵奖得主姚期智在清华大学创办“姚班”，培养计算机领域的顶尖人才。与此同时，唐杰长期在清华从事数据挖掘和机器学习研究，其实验室后来成为中国 AI 人才的重要来源之一。杨植麟曾师从唐杰，在清华研究机器学习算法，随后赴卡内基梅隆大学攻读博士，回国后创办月之暗面。 这种高校与创业公司的人员流动逐渐形成了一张 AI 人才网络。2018 年，中国进一步放宽科研人员创业及科研成果商业化限制，次年唐杰从清华实验室孵化出后来发展为智谱 AI 的公司。早在 OpenAI 于 2020 年发布 GPT-3 后，智谱…
items.summary_en: A Wall Street Journal report says China's top AI models are now only months behind the US, driven not by a sudden breakthrough but by a long-built talent network from Tsinghua University, plus open source, talent repatriation, and compute efficiency. Key figures include Zhipu AI's Tang Jie, Moonshot AI's Yang Zhilin, and DeepSeek's Liang Wenfeng. The report traces the roots to Andrew Yao's 2005 "Yao Class" at Tsinghua and notes Musk's prediction that China would catch up by early 2027, which Tang said would be sooner.
items.why_zh: 这是西方主流媒体对中国AI追赶路径的系统性分析，点明其人才与体制优势。
items.why_en: This is a systematic Western media analysis of how China's AI catch-up rests on talent networks and institutional advantages, not just a single breakthrough.

items.title_zh: 量化地理领域偏移：解耦人类移动流生成模型的地理空间可迁移性
items.title_en: Quantifying geographic domain shift to decouple the geospatial transferability of human mobility flow generation models
items.summary_zh: 该研究于8月25日发布在arXiv（编号2608.21567），聚焦人类移动流生成模型的地理空间可迁移性。地理空间可迁移性衡量模型在全新或未见区域的表现，是不同移动生成模型比较的关键维度，但此前鲜有研究深入其内在机制。作者利用大规模数据集，系统评估了四种代表性人类移动流生成模型的可迁移性，并尝试量化地理领域偏移，从而将数据分布差异与模型自身能力分离开来。这一方法有助于理解模型在跨城市、跨区域应用时的泛化瓶颈，为城市系统的人口流动建模和预测提供更可靠的评估框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.21567v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Human mobility serves as an essential proxy for understanding social, economic, and environmental dynamics in urban systems. Geospatial transferability, which measures a model's capability in a new location or unseen region, is a critical dimension for comparing different human mobility generation models. However, few studies have studied the intrinsic characteristics of geospatial transferability. To this end, this study systematically investigates the geospatial transferability of four representative human mobility generation models using a lar…
items.why_zh: 这项研究填补了移动流生成模型在可迁移性评估上的空白，对智慧城市和位置智能领域有方法论价值。
items.why_en: This work fills a gap in evaluating the geo-transferability of mobility models, offering methodological value for smart city and location intelligence research.

items.title_zh: 可复现且许可感知的蒸馏方案：在CPU上实现安全分类模型部署
items.title_en: A Reproducible, License-Aware Distillation Recipe for CPUDeployable Safety Classification
items.summary_zh: 这篇arXiv论文（编号2608.21570）提出了一种可复现、许可感知的知识蒸馏方案，旨在将大语言模型的安全分类能力部署到CPU上。当前开源守卫模型参数量在1B到9B之间，主要面向GPU，且在CPU上每个请求需数秒响应。新方案使用一个强开放守卫模型，从24个公共数据集中抽取约9.7万条提示词，标注为与公开安全标准对齐的七个安全类别，从而蒸馏出更小、更适合CPU部署的模型。该方法有望降低安全层部署的硬件门槛，提升推理效率，同时保持许可合规。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.21570v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deploying a safety layer for large language models on commodity hardware is constrained by the guards available to do it: current open guard models hold between 1 and 9 billion parameters, are oriented toward the graphics processing unit, and answer in seconds per request on a central processing unit. This paper presents a reproducible, license-aware knowledge-distillation recipe addressing that constraint. A strong open guard labels a corpus of roughly 97,000 prompts, drawn from 24 public datasets, into seven safety categories aligned to a publi…
items.why_zh: 这一方案使得企业无需高端GPU即可在普通CPU上部署大模型安全层，对AI安全落地有直接实用价值。
items.why_en: It enables deploying LLM safety layers on commodity CPUs without high-end GPUs, directly advancing practical AI safety deployment.

items.title_zh: CLIP在区域地理定位中学到了什么？适配后的视觉线索与场景配置探析
items.title_en: What Does CLIP Learn for Regional Geolocalization? Probing Visual Cues and Scene Configuration After Adaptation
items.summary_zh: 该研究探讨了在大都市区域内进行细粒度地理定位时，预训练CLIP特征是否足以区分不同区域，以及模型经过适配后依赖哪些视觉信息。利用9085张街景图像，研究分析了视觉线索和场景配置对区域判别的作用。由于邻近地区常共享粗粒度的地理线索，细粒度区域定位具有挑战性。该工作有助于揭示CLIP在空间感知任务中的学习机制，为基于视觉的地理定位系统提供改进方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.21761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large collections of street-view imagery provide rich visual information about urban environments, but extracting fine-grained geographic information from such data remains challenging. In particular, fine-grained regional geolocalization is challenging because nearby areas often share coarse geographic cues. We study regional geolocalization within a metropolitan area and ask whether pretrained CLIP features are sufficient for regional discrimination, and what visual information supports performance after adaptation. Using 9,085 street-view imag…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了预训练视觉语言模型在地理空间任务中的可迁移性，对城市级视觉定位技术有直接参考价值。
items.why_en: This study clarifies the strengths and limitations of CLIP for regional geolocalization, informing future visual positioning systems.

items.title_zh: 超越所见：揭示多模态大语言模型的情境错觉
items.title_en: Beyond What Meets the Eye: Unveiling Situational Illusions for Multimodal Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出“情境错觉”这一概念，指真实世界中的表象可能与潜在物理状态不一致，从而挑战多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的可靠性。作者构建了“何处-何物-如何”（where-what-how）分类体系，系统刻画情境错觉发生的位置、目标和成因。基于该分类体系，他们引入了MSIBench基准，用于评估MLLM在面对情境错觉时的表现，并探索缓解这些局限的方法。该工作为提升多模态模型在复杂真实场景中的鲁棒性提供了新的评测工具和思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22232v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-world situation appearances can deviate from their underlying physical states, challenging the reliability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in practical applications. In this paper, we term this phenomenon situational illusions and investigate: (1) how MLLMs perform under such illusions, and (2) how to mitigate the limitations. We first develop a comprehensive where-what-how taxonomy that characterizes where situational illusions occur, what targets they take, and how they arise. Building on this taxonomy, we introduce MSIBench, a…
items.why_zh: 该工作为多模态大模型的鲁棒性评测开辟了新方向，有助于推动模型在真实动态场景中的可靠性。
items.why_en: This work provides a systematic benchmark and taxonomy for a previously overlooked failure mode in multimodal LLMs, advancing real-world reliability.

items.title_zh: LLM用于调查文本分析：人类与GPT-5在归纳式内容分析中的表现比较
items.title_en: LLMs for Survey Text Analysis - A Performance Comparison Between Humans and GPT-5 on Inductive Content Analysis
items.summary_zh: 该研究比较了人类编码员与大语言模型（GPT-5.4）在开放式调查问卷归纳式内容分析中的表现。研究使用了来自欧洲博士生调查的903条回答，涵盖六个变量。五位人类编码员遵循标准化编码方案进行归纳式内容分析，而GPT-5.4则采用既定的提示词流程完成相同任务。研究评估了人类与模型之间的一致性，为LLM在定性研究文本分析中的应用提供了实证依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22417v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support text analysis in qualitative research, yet evidence on their performance in inductive content analysis remains limited. This study compares human and LLM-based inductive coding of open-ended survey responses from 903 answers across six variables from a European PhD student survey. Five human coders performed inductive content analysis following a standardized coding scheme, while an LLM (GPT-5.4) conducted the same task using an established prompting procedure. Agreement between human…
items.why_zh: 该研究为LLM在定性研究中的可靠性和适用性提供了直接比较证据，对社会科学研究方法有启示。
items.why_en: This study offers empirical evidence on whether LLMs can reliably support qualitative content analysis, informing research workflows.

items.title_zh: ClawProBench：面向运行时覆盖率与冻结工作区式保留集的AI智能体轨迹感知评估
items.title_en: ClawProBench: Trace-Aware Evaluation of AI Agents with Runtime Coverage and Frozen Workplace-Style Holdouts
items.summary_zh: 该论文指出，现有AI智能体基准通常只评估最终答案，忽略了智能体运行在有状态运行时环境中的过程。作者认为正确的评测单位应是“模型+运行时”的配置，因为失败可能发生在证据获取、运行时路由、安全边界或重复执行等环节。为此，他们提出了ClawProBench，一个基于轨迹感知的基准，适用于运行时原生的智能体评估，并在OpenClaw这一实时智能体运行时上实现。该基准覆盖了工作区工具以及浏览、记忆、消息、调度、技能等原生功能，旨在更全面地评估智能体在实际执行中的表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22510v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent benchmarks often evaluate only final answers even when agents run on stateful runtimes. We argue this under-specifies what is being evaluated: the proper unit is a declared model-plus-runtime configuration whose failures can occur in evidence acquisition, runtime routing, safety boundaries, or repeated execution. We present ClawProBench, a trace-aware benchmark for runtime-native agent evaluation instantiated on OpenClaw, a live agent runtime with workspace tools and native surfaces for browsing, memory, messaging, scheduling, skills, and s…
items.why_zh: 该基准弥补了智能体评估中只重结果、不重过程的缺陷，为运行时智能体的可靠性和安全性评测提供新方法。
items.why_en: This work addresses a critical gap in agent evaluation by emphasizing runtime behavior and failure modes, improving reliability assessment.

items.title_zh: STAGE：带策略作用域上下文和确定性控制的状态化智能体图执行转换
items.title_en: STAGE: Stateful Translation to Agentic Graph Execution with Policy-Scoped Context and Deterministic Control
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出STAGE框架，一种可执行图框架，用于受政策约束的智能体执行。STAGE将模型判断限制在政策范围内的节点处，而将程序性控制交给确定性代码处理。在每个节点，模型接收任务相关的政策上下文并返回类型化结果，协调器则强制执行经过审查的执行契约。该框架在SOP-Bench Referral Abuse、两个τ²-bench领域以及专有银行基准Smart Dispute上进行了评估。STAGE旨在通过分离模型判断与程序控制，提升政策驱动型智能体的合规性和可控性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22538v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Policy-governed agents must interpret case evidence while following an authorized procedure. We present \textsc{Stage}, an executable-graph framework that confines model judgment to policy-scoped nodes while placing procedural control in deterministic code. At each node, the model receives task-relevant policy context and returns a typed result, while the coordinator enforces the reviewed execution contract. We evaluate \textsc{Stage} on SOP-Bench Referral Abuse, two $\tau^2$-bench domains, and Smart Dispute, a proprietary banking benchmark. Comp…
items.why_zh: 该框架为政策敏感的智能体应用提供了模型判断与程序控制的解耦方案，具有实用价值。
items.why_en: STAGE offers a principled approach to balancing model flexibility with policy compliance in agentic systems.

items.title_zh: 自进化智能体的联盟感知技能可靠性
items.title_en: Coalition-Aware Skill Reliability for Self-Evolving Agents
items.summary_zh: 该研究关注自进化智能体技能库的可靠性问题。智能体技能是从交互轨迹中提炼的结构化产物，可被动态复用，但现有研究多关注技能的获取、演化和检索，未深入探讨积累的技能是否真正对机制有正向贡献。作者针对这一问题展开研究，提出“联盟感知”（coalition-aware）的视角来评估技能可靠性，即考虑技能间协作关系对整体机制的影响。该工作为自进化智能体的技能管理提供了新的评估维度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent skills, structured artifacts distilled from interaction trajectories and dynamically reused from skill banks, have become a central mechanism for enabling large language model (LLM)-based self-evolving agents to learn from past experience. Yet existing work has largely focused on the operational aspects of skills, such as acquisition, evolution, and retrieval, while leaving a more fundamental reliability question unresolved: Do accumulated skills in an agent's skill bank actually make positive mechanistic contributions? We investigate this…
items.why_zh: 该研究首次从协作机制角度评估技能库的可靠性，有助于理解自进化智能体的学习效率。
items.why_en: This work provides a new lens on skill reliability in self-evolving agents, potentially improving skill bank design.

items.title_zh: 论引用在偏好数据中的作用
items.title_en: On the Role of Citations in Preference Data
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究引用（citation）在偏好数据中的作用。许多NLP任务要求输出附带引用以支持依据，但人类和LLM在比较输出时如何评估引用仍不明确，而这对于奖励建模和现代LLM后训练至关重要。作者在科学问答场景下，研究了人类评审和四种开源LLM对引用的偏好。研究有助于理解引用如何影响模型输出的可信度评估，并为奖励建模提供参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.21376v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many NLP tasks require systems to provide attribution in their outputs--i.e. citations to grounding sources. Attribution serves as a bulwark against model hallucination and as a means for users to verify the credibility of model outputs. Yet, it is unclear how humans and LLMs evaluate citations when comparing outputs, a process central to reward modeling and modern LLM post-training. This paper studies the role of citations in the preferences of human judges and four open-source LLMs within the context of scientific question answering, leveragi…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了引用在偏好评估中的作用，对改进LLM奖励建模和减少幻觉有直接意义。
items.why_en: Understanding citation effects in preference data is key to building trustworthy reward models and reducing hallucination.

items.title_zh: CRS-Bench：医学图像编码器的参考相对可靠性基准
items.title_en: CRS-Bench: A Reference-Relative Reliability Benchmark for Medical Image Encoders
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出CRS-Bench，一个用于医学图像编码器的参考相对可靠性基准。由于专家标注成本高昂，预训练编码器在医学图像分类中至关重要，且模型选择从通用型扩展到专用型。仅靠干净测试集上的判别性能（如AUROC）不足以全面评估编码器，因为相同AUROC的模型在校准、标签效率和稳定性上可能存在差异。CRS-Bench旨在评估编码器在获取扰动或分布偏移等条件下的可靠性，为医学图像表示选择提供更充分的依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22059v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pretrained image encoders are central to medical image classification, where expert annotation is costly and task-specific cohorts are often limited. As the model space expands from general-purpose to broad-medical and specialty-specific encoders, selecting the representation becomes a substantive modeling decision. Clean-test discrimination alone is insufficient for this purpose: encoders with similar AUROC can differ in calibration, label efficiency, and stability under acquisition perturbations or distribution shift. We introduce CRS-Bench,…
items.why_zh: 该基准为医学图像编码器的选择提供了超越传统准确率的可靠性评估，具有临床应用价值。
items.why_en: This benchmark helps select robust medical image encoders by evaluating reliability beyond top-line accuracy, crucial for clinical deployment.

items.title_zh: 使用上下文学习预测漏洞严重性：一项工业案例研究
items.title_en: On Predicting Vulnerability Severity Using In-Context Learning: An Industrial Case Study
items.summary_zh: 现代软件系统需要更早且可扩展的漏洞严重性评估，以降低高影响安全缺陷的暴露风险。安全分析师通常手动分配CVSS评分，但这种方式无法跟上漏洞披露的增长，且依赖云LLM服务会带来保密性问题。本文提出了一项工业案例研究，利用本地可部署的开源LLM，通过上下文学习直接从易受攻击的C/C++代码片段预测CVSS v3.1评分。研究比较了不同方法。这有助于在保密前提下提高漏洞严重性评估的效率和可扩展性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22089v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern software systems require earlier and more scalable vulnerability severity assessment to reduce exposure to high-impact security flaws. Security analysts typically assign CVSS scores, but this manual triage does not scale with the growth of disclosed vulnerabilities and often depends on cloud LLM services that raise confidentiality concerns. This paper presents an industrial case study on predicting CVSS v3.1 scores directly from vulnerable C/C++ snippets using in-context learning with locally deployable, open-source LLMs. We compare prop…
items.why_zh: 该研究提供了一种不依赖云端、可扩展的漏洞严重性自动评估方法，兼顾安全性和效率。
items.why_en: It offers a scalable, confidentiality-preserving approach to automatic vulnerability severity assessment using local open-source LLMs.

items.title_zh: KONTOGRAPH：200毫秒决策预算下实时反洗钱的验证点时间特征一致性与摊销解释
items.title_en: KONTOGRAPH: Verified Point-in-Time Feature Consistency and Amortised Explanation for Real-Time Anti-Money Laundering under a 200 ms Decision Budget
items.summary_zh: 欧盟法规(EU) 2024/886要求欧洲支付服务提供商在十秒内全天候结算欧元信用转账，这消除了传统的隔夜批量反洗钱分析窗口，也取消了使资金追回成为可能的结算延迟，迫使检测、解释和决策必须在个位数秒内完成。为此，KONTOGRAPH提出了一个针对SEPA Instant系统的端到端反洗钱流水线，在自设的200毫秒第99百分位预算下运行。该系统验证了点时间特征一致性，并提供了摊销解释。该研究为即时支付场景下的合规检测提供了高效可解释的解决方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22389v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Regulation (EU) 2024/886 obliges European payment service providers to settle euro credit transfers in under ten seconds, around the clock. This removes both the overnight batch window in which anti-money-laundering (AML) analytics traditionally ran and the settlement delay that made recovery possible, forcing detection, explanation and decision inside a single-digit-second envelope. We present KONTOGRAPH, an end-to-end AML pipeline for the SEPA Instant rail built under a self-imposed 200 ms 99th-percentile budget, and report an empirical study…
items.why_zh: 该方案证明了在200毫秒内完成实时反洗钱检测、解释和决策的可行性，满足新法规的极致时效要求。
items.why_en: It demonstrates the feasibility of completing AML detection, explanation, and decision within 200 ms, meeting stringent new regulatory time limits.

items.title_zh: 黑盒大模型分类推理的层级感知监督不确定性估计
items.title_en: Hierarchy-Aware Supervised Uncertainty Estimation for Black-box LLM Taxonomic Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地用于科学决策支持，但在黑盒环境中可靠地估计置信度仍然困难。该研究针对黑盒LLM在长尾生物多样性监测流程中生成的层级分类推理，探讨不确定性估计问题。研究者利用开源工具LLM提取的代理特征，训练轻量级监督估计器，并采用层级感知监督来预测每个层级的正确性。在三个工具LLM上，该监督估计器一致优于现有方法。这项研究有助于提升黑盒LLM在科学任务中的可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22839v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for scientific decision support, yet reliable confidence estimation remains difficult in black-box settings. We study uncertainty estimation for hierarchical taxonomic reasoning generated by a black-box LLM in a long-tailed biodiversity monitoring pipeline. Using proxy features extracted by an open-source tool LLM, we train lightweight supervised estimators with hierarchy-aware supervision to predict rank-wise correctness. Across three tool LLMs, the supervised estimators consistently outperfor…
items.why_zh: 通过层级感知监督为黑盒LLM提供更可靠的置信度估计，推动其在科学决策支持中的安全应用。
items.why_en: It provides more reliable confidence estimates for black-box LLMs via hierarchy-aware supervision, supporting safer use in scientific decision support.

items.title_zh: 多语言FrameNet语料库
items.title_en: The Multilingual FrameNet Corpus
items.summary_zh: 该论文介绍了多语言FrameNet语料库（mFNC），这是一个新资源，通过收集和协调九种语言（巴西葡萄牙语、中文、荷兰语、法语、德语、意大利语、韩语、拉脱维亚语、瑞典语）的现有特定语言语料库，扩展了英语伯克利FrameNet语料库。研究者在mFNC上训练了基于不同架构的模型，在多语言和跨语言设置中持续超越了现有最优的Frame语义解析器。该资源强调了多语言数据在提升语义解析性能方面的重要性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.23037v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper introduces the Multilingual FrameNet Corpus (mFNC), a novel resource that extends the English Berkeley FrameNet corpus by collecting and harmonizing existing language-specific corpora across nine additional languages: Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Korean, Latvian and Swedish. By training models that rely on different architectures on the mFNC, we consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art Frame Semantic Parsers in both multilingual and cross-lingual settings, underscoring the importance of mult…
items.why_zh: mFNC填补了多语言FrameNet资源的空白，显著提升了跨语言语义解析性能。
items.why_en: mFNC fills the gap in multilingual FrameNet resources and significantly improves cross-lingual semantic parsing.

items.title_zh: 超越视频思考：统一视频推理与深度研究以构建开放世界视频代理
items.title_en: Thinking Beyond Videos: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Open-World Video Agents
items.summary_zh: 开放世界视频理解通常要求模型定位稀疏的视觉证据，并获取视频及其参数记忆中不存在的外部知识。现有的“边看边思考”能力支持主动时间感知，而“深度研究”支持多步信息寻求，但两者往往被孤立开发。为此，研究者提出了VideoRover，一个统一的视频深度研究框架，能够迭代地协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索和网页浏览。给定视频-问题对，VideoRover能够利用外部资源进行多步推理。该研究为开放世界视频问答提供了更强大的智能体。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.23329v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open-world video understanding often requires a model to locate sparse visual evidence and acquire external knowledge that is absent from the video and its parametric memory. While Thinking-with-Videos enables active temporal perception and Deep Research supports multi-step information seeking, the two capabilities are typically developed in isolation. We introduce VideoRover, a unified Video Deep Research framework that iteratively coordinates video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing. Given a video-question pair, VideoRover uses…
items.why_zh: VideoRover首次将视频推理与多步外部信息检索统一，显著增强了开放世界视频智能体的能力。
items.why_en: VideoRover unifies video reasoning with multi-step external retrieval, enhancing open-world video agents.

items.title_zh: 记忆增强模型的阿谀奉承：评估与缓解
items.title_en: Recalling Too Well: Sycophancy Evaluation and Mitigation in Memory-Augmented Models
items.summary_zh: 持久记忆系统通过长期存储用户信念来让LLM更有帮助，但研究显示，它们也会放大模型的阿谀奉承倾向——即模型优先迎合用户而非追求准确性。该研究首次系统评估了这一效应，并引入基准MIST：一个合成生成的多轮对话数据集，其中用户在科学、医学和道德推理领域表达看似有理的误解。在三个最先进的记忆系统和五个模型族上的测试揭示了该问题的普遍性，并提出了相应的缓解策略。研究提醒我们，在追求个性化和长期记忆时需谨慎权衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.10949v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Persistent memory systems promise to make LLMs more helpful by storing user beliefs over time. We show they also make models less correct by amplifying sycophancy, wherein models prioritize agreement with users over accuracy. We conduct the first systematic evaluation of this effect, introducing MIST: a benchmark of synthetically generated multi-turn conversations where users express plausible misconceptions in scientific, medical, and moral reasoning domains. Testing across three state-of-the-art memory systems and five model families reveal…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了记忆增强LLM会放大迎合用户而非准确性的风险，对个性化AI的安全设计具有警示意义。
items.why_en: It reveals that memory augmentation amplifies sycophancy, a critical safety concern for personalized AI.

items.title_zh: 重新审视Agentic-SQL：面向LLM文本到SQL的基于自主性的分类与实证基准分析
items.title_en: Agentic-SQL Revisited: Autonomy-Based Taxonomy and Empirical Benchmark Analysis for LLM Text-to-SQL
items.summary_zh: 基于LLM的文本到SQL进展在异构基准、骨干模型和推理协议上报告，导致跨系统比较不可靠。该研究将该领域重新定义为排行榜聚合：收集作者报告的指标，并按推理自主性轴进行组织，涵盖了从受约束、上下文内、迭代、代理到推理内化的生成方式，每个单元格都带有可追溯的来源。为了锚定聚合结果，研究者在Spider基准上进行了聚焦案例研究，比较了8B开源骨干模型。该分类法为评估LLM文本到SQL系统提供了更清晰的框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15389v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: LLM-based Text-to-SQL progress is reported across heterogeneous benchmarks, backbones, and inference protocols, making cross-system comparison fragile. We reframe the field as a leaderboard aggregation: we collect the metrics authors themselves report and organize them along an inference-autonomy axis spanning constrained, in-context, iterative, agentic, and reasoning-internalized generation, with traceable provenance for every cell. To anchor the aggregation empirically, we run a focused case study on Spider, comparing 8B open-source backbon…
items.why_zh: 提出了基于自主性的分类法，使各自报告的LLM文本到SQL结果可比较，减少评估混乱。
items.why_en: It provides an autonomy-based taxonomy for comparing heterogeneous LLM text-to-SQL results, reducing benchmark confusion.

items.title_zh: AI-U：面向工程的LLM驱动学习助手——有限元方法案例研究
items.title_en: AI University: An LLM-Powered Learning Assistant for Engineering---A Finite Element Method Case Study
items.summary_zh: 该论文介绍了AI-U（AI University），一个灵活的人工智能驱动课程内容交付框架，能够适应课程的教学风格。AI-U结合了微调的大语言模型、检索增强生成（RAG）和推理合成模型，从讲座视频、笔记和教材中生成风格一致的回答。研究以研究生水平的有限元方法（FEM）课程为案例，提出了一条用于合成课程基础训练数据的流水线，并使用低秩适配（LoRA）微调开源LLM。该系统有望为工程教育提供个性化、风格统一的AI学习辅助。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2504.08846v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce AI University (AI-U), a flexible framework for AI-driven course content delivery that adapts to a course's instructional style. AI-U combines a fine-tuned large language model (LLM) with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and a reasoning synthesis model to generate style-aligned responses from lecture videos, notes, and textbooks. Using a graduate-level finite-element-method (FEM) course as a case study, we present a pipeline to synthesize course-grounded training data, fine-tune an open-source LLM with Low-Rank Adaptatio…
items.why_zh: AI-U展示了如何快速构建贴合课程教学风格的AI助教，为工程教育智能化提供了可复制框架。
items.why_en: It shows a flexible framework for creating style-aligned AI course assistants, advancing AI-enabled engineering education.

items.title_zh: PathAgentBench：在全切片病理图像上基准测试证据搜寻视觉语言模型
items.title_en: PathAgentBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Seeking Vision-Language Models on Whole-Slide Pathology Image
items.summary_zh: 全切片图像（WSI）诊断要求识别诊断相关区域、跨放大倍数检查并整合多尺度证据。然而，现有病理学基准大多在预裁剪的图像块或预提取的切片特征上评估模型，导致模型直接从千兆像素级 WSI 中获取证据的能力未得到充分测试。为此，研究者提出 PathAgentBench 基准，用于评估证据搜寻型视觉语言模型（VLM）在四种互补能力上的表现，其中包括图像-文本匹配等。该基准有望推动病理学 VLM 从依赖人工裁剪特征向端到端证据获取方向发展，为病理 AI 提供更贴近真实诊断流程的评估标准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.19261v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Whole-slide image (WSI) diagnosis requires identifying diagnostically relevant regions, examining them across magnifications, and integrating multi-scale evidence. However, most existing pathology benchmarks evaluate models on pre-cropped patches or pre-extracted slide features, leaving their ability to acquire evidence directly from gigapixel WSIs largely untested. We introduce PathAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating evidence-seeking vision-language models (VLMs) across four complementary capabilities: image-to-text matching for evi…
items.why_zh: 它填补了病理 AI 评估中“直接从千兆像素全切片图像获取证据”这一关键空白，推动模型更贴近真实诊断场景。
items.why_en: It fills a critical gap in pathology AI evaluation by testing models on direct evidence acquisition from gigapixel whole-slide images, moving closer to real diagnostic workflows.

items.title_zh: 扣留完成块：生产流式护栏的精确释放边界等价性
items.title_en: Withholding the Completing Chunk: Exact Release-Boundary Equivalence for Production Streaming Guardrails
items.summary_zh: 流式语言模型输出会产生一个执行边界：如果某个控制在完成块释放之后才检测到禁止模式，则无法撤回该内容。文章研究一种生产策略，其中每个有序族由两个正则语言谓词合取而成。增量匹配是经典方法，但问题在于发布时跨任意块分割的精确组合，包括在扩展时可能变化的前缀末尾词边界。为此，研究者定义了 ASCII 显式策略语法，并将每个谓词编译为面向流式检查的形式。这项工作旨在为流式内容安全护栏提供精确的释放边界等价性，防止违规内容在输出后逃逸。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.10279v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Streaming language-model output creates an enforcement boundary: a control that detects a prohibited pattern after releasing its completing chunk cannot recall it. We study a production policy in which each ordered family is the conjunction of two regular-language predicates. Incremental matching is classical. The problem is exact composition at release time across arbitrary chunk partitions, including end-of-prefix word boundaries that can change on extension. We define an ASCII-explicit policy grammar, compile each predicate to a pers…
items.why_zh: 它解决了流式语言模型内容安全中一个关键问题：如何在块释放后无法撤回的情况下，仍能精确阻止违规内容。
items.why_en: It addresses a critical challenge in streaming guardrails—ensuring prohibited content is detected exactly at release boundaries before it can be released, despite the inability to recall after completion.

items.title_zh: 基于加权集成学习的网球多模态损伤风险与表现预测
items.title_en: Multimodal Injury Risk and Performance Prediction in Tennis Using Weighted Ensemble Learning
items.summary_zh: 机器学习已在体育行业产生积极影响，其中预测运动员表现和运动损伤风险是最有前景的应用之一。尽管近期研究采用先进模型提升了预测准确率，但进展仍受制于数据可得性以及对主观观察和专家评估的依赖。为此，足球、篮球、摔跤等项目的研究者开始融合可穿戴设备读数等异构数据源，以弥补单一信号的不足。这项研究面向网球项目，提出基于加权集成学习的多模态预测方法，用于综合评估运动员的损伤风险与赛场表现。该方法有望减少对专家主观判断的依赖，为运动员健康管理和训练决策提供更客观的数据支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.21530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning has had a positive impact on the sports industry, with one of its most promising applications being the prediction of athlete performance and injury risk. Recent advances have employed state-of-the-art models to improve prediction accuracy, yet progress remains limited by data availability and the reliance on subjective observations or expert assessments. To address these limitations, researchers in sports such as soccer, basketball, and wrestling have begun integrating heterogeneous data sources, such as wearable device readings…
items.why_zh: 因为它探索了利用多模态数据和集成学习提升网球运动员损伤风险与表现预测的客观性，有助于减少主观评估依赖。
items.why_en: It demonstrates how multimodal data and weighted ensemble learning can make injury risk and performance prediction in tennis more objective and data-driven.

items.title_zh: ChequeMark：用于非工作时间商务存款欺诈检测的集成机器学习框架
items.title_en: ChequeMark: An Ensemble Machine Learning Framework for After-Hours Business Deposit Fraud Detection
items.summary_zh: 支票欺诈是非工作时间商务存款业务中的重大风险：资金可能在一个工作日内到账，而支票清算往往需要数天，这一时间差为金融机构留下欺诈敞口。传统缓解手段多依赖静态的存款级检查，无法捕捉历史客户行为和不断演变的欺诈模式。为此，研究者提出 ChequeMark，一个多视角集成机器学习框架，通过组合 XGBoost 识别已知欺诈模式、孤立森林进行无标签异常检测等模块来提升检测能力。该框架旨在弥补时间差带来的风险窗口，增强金融机构对下班后存款业务的欺诈识别能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.21629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cheque fraud is a material risk in after-hours business deposit operations because funds may be released within one business day, while cheque clearing takes several days. This timing gap creates a fraud exposure window for financial institutions. Prior mitigation relies on static, deposit-level checks and therefore miss historical client behavior and evolving patterns. To address this gap, we propose a multi-view ensemble ML framework that combines: Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) for known fraud patterns, Isolation Forest for label-free ano…
items.why_zh: 它针对资金释放与支票清算之间的时间差，提出多模型集成框架，能利用历史行为识别未知欺诈模式，增强金融机构的风险防控。
items.why_en: It addresses the time-gap fraud exposure in after-hours deposits by combining supervised and unsupervised ML to capture both known and evolving fraud patterns.

items.title_zh: 缓解金融欺诈检测系统中的解释泄漏
items.title_en: Mitigating Explanation Leakage in Financial Fraud Detection Systems
items.summary_zh: 金融欺诈检测高度依赖集中式机器学习模型，这会带来严重的数据隐私风险。联邦学习（FL）虽能去中心化数据处理，但金融监管仍要求模型可解释，因此需要 TreeSHAP 等可解释 AI（XAI）工具。然而最新网络安全研究指出，共享高保真 SHAP 解释会使联邦网络暴露于成员推断攻击（MIA）之下。为此，该论文提出并评估了一种名为 DP-FedSHAP 的新架构，旨在缓解共享解释导致的成员推断攻击风险，在满足金融透明度要求的同时增强隐私保护。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22607v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Financial fraud detection relies heavily on centralized machine learning models. This creates serious data privacy risks. Federated Learning (FL) decentralizes data processing, but financial regulations still require models to be transparent. This means using Explainable AI (XAI) tools such as TreeSHAP. Recent cybersecurity research shows a problem with this approach. Sharing high-fidelity SHAP explanations exposes the federated network to Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs). This dissertation proposes and evaluates DP-FedSHAP. It is a new archit…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了在金融风控中追求模型可解释性可能引发成员隐私泄露的隐患，并提出 DP-FedSHAP 这一平衡方案，对合规与安全至关重要。
items.why_en: It highlights a critical privacy risk from sharing XAI explanations in federated fraud detection and proposes a solution to balance transparency with security.

items.title_zh: KMGen：一种基于技能的合成个体患者数据生成方法
items.title_en: KMGen: A Skill-based Approach for Synthetic Individual Patient Data Generation
items.summary_zh: 临床试验的个体患者数据（IPD）是生存建模、荟萃分析和安全性研究的基础，但很少被公开。此前研究只填补了部分空白：从已发表图表中重建 Kaplan-Meier（KM）曲线，且通常依赖手动数字化或人机协同校正；同时缺乏生成不良事件（AE）记录的能力，而这是患者记录的另一半。为此，研究者提出 KMGen，一个端到端框架，旨在全自动重建 KM 曲线并生成与患者记录对应的不良事件流。该框架有望缓解 IPD 不可得的问题，为生存分析和药物安全研究提供更完整的合成数据支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.22618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Individual patient data (IPD) from clinical trials is the substrate for survival modeling, meta-analysis, and safety research, yet IPD is rarely released. Prior work has addressed only half of this gap: reconstructing Kaplan-Meier (KM) curves from published plots -- typically requiring manual digitization or human-in-the-loop correction -- while offering no mechanism for generating the adverse-event (AE) streams that constitute the other half of a patient record. We introduce KMGen, the first end-to-end framework that (i) fully automates KM curve…
items.why_zh: 它解决了生成合成 IPD 时缺少不良事件数据的问题，为生存分析和药物安全研究提供更完整的合成数据来源。
items.why_en: It addresses the missing adverse-event half in synthetic patient data, enabling more complete survival and safety analyses without accessing real IPD.

items.title_zh: 利用远程交通数据估算本地空气污染物：一项横跨伦敦监测站的多场景机器学习研究
items.title_en: Leveraging Remote Traffic Data for Local Air Pollutant Estimation: A Scenario-Based Machine Learning Study Across London Monitoring Sites
items.summary_zh: 机动车交通是空气污染的主要来源，但远程获取的交通信息对本地机器学习空气质量模型究竟有多大贡献，此前研究并不充分。这项研究以伦敦多个监测站为对象，系统评估了随机森林、Extra Trees、LightGBM 和 XGBoost 四种可解释的基于树的机器学习模型。研究设置了六种预测变量场景，从仅使用远程采集的交通、气象和时间变量，逐步扩展到纳入邻近一个或四个监测站的测量数据。通过比较不同场景下的模型表现，作者希望厘清远程交通数据在本地污染物估算中的实际价值及最佳变量组合。该研究为缺乏本地监测数据的地区利用远程交通数据估算空气质量提供了实证依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.23219v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vehicular traffic is a major source of air pollution; however, the contribution of remotely acquired traffic information to local machine-learning (ML) air-pollution models remains insufficiently characterised. This study evaluates four interpretable tree-based ML models (Random Forest, Extra Trees, LightGBM, and XGBoost) under six predictor scenarios combining progressively larger predictor sets, ranging from remotely acquired traffic, meteorological, and temporal variables alone to the inclusion of measurements from one and four neighbouring mo…
items.why_zh: 它系统评估了远程交通数据在本地空气污染建模中的增量贡献，为监测数据不足地区提供可操作的机器学习方案。
items.why_en: It quantifies how much remote traffic data improves local air pollution models, guiding model design for areas lacking dense monitoring stations.

items.title_zh: 基于 SQI 门控自训练与心跳-节律一致性的 ECG 分类测试时适应
items.title_en: Test-Time Adaptation for ECG Classification via SQI-Gated Self-Training and Beat-Rhythm Consistency
items.summary_zh: 心电图（ECG）分类深度学习模型在跨设备或跨人群部署时常因数据分布偏移而出现明显性能下降。测试时适应（TTA）是一种可行的思路，可在推理阶段仅利用无标签数据调整模型。但现有 TTA 方法在 ECG 任务上效果有限：朴素的在线更新既没有考虑心脏电活动的层级心拍-节律结构，又容易受信号伪影干扰，导致适应过程不稳定。为此，这篇论文提出将 SQI 门控的自训练与心拍-节律一致性约束相结合，以提升 TTA 在 ECG 上的鲁棒性。该工作有望帮助 ECG 模型在真实临床新环境部署时保持较高准确性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.23347v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep learning models for electrocardiogram (ECG) classification often suffer from significant performance degradation when deployed in unseen domains due to shifts in acquisition devices and patient populations. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical solution by adapting models using only unlabeled data at inference time. However, existing TTA methods often underperform on ECG tasks, since naive online updates ignore the hierarchical beat-rhythm structure of cardiac cycles and are vulnerable to signal artifacts, which leads to unstable ada…
items.why_zh: 它针对 ECG 部署时数据分布偏移问题，提出一种融合 SQI 门控与节律一致性的测试时适应方法，有助于提升模型在新环境下的可靠性。
items.why_en: It improves test-time adaptation robustness for ECG models by incorporating signal-quality gating and beat-rhythm structure, addressing domain shift in clinical deployment.

items.title_zh: 用于观看时间分布预测的分层指数-高斯混合模型
items.title_en: Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixtures for Watch-Time Distribution Prediction
items.summary_zh: 准确观看时间预测是短视频推荐的重要需求。然而，观看时间分布呈现零膨胀、长尾且多峰的特点。现有指数-高斯混合网络（EGMN）虽能建模完整条件分布并达到最优性能，但在大规模复现中暴露出方差崩溃、组件冗余和无效组件等问题。为此，研究者提出分层指数-高斯混合（HEGM）模型来应对这些缺陷，从而更稳健地预测观看时间分布。该工作有望提升短视频推荐系统的精准度与用户体验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.23356v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate watch-time (WT) prediction is an important requirement for short-video recommendations. Yet WT distributions are near-zero-inflated, long-tailed and multimodal. The recent Exponential-Gaussian Mixture Network (EGMN) models the full conditional WT distribution rather than a single point estimate and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our large-scale reproduction study reveals that EGMN is vulnerable to variance collapse, component redundancy, and inactive components. We propose a Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixture (HEGM) mode…
items.why_zh: 改进观看时间预测模型可显著提升短视频推荐系统的准确性和用户满意度。
items.why_en: Improving watch-time prediction models can significantly enhance the accuracy and user satisfaction of short-video recommendation systems.

items.title_zh: PRAGMA：面向银行事件序列的金融基础模型
items.title_en: PRAGMA: Revolut Foundation Model
items.summary_zh: 现代金融系统产生海量的交易和事件级数据，蕴含丰富的经济信号。这篇论文提出PRAGMA，一个面向银行事件序列的基础模型家族。该方法采用基于Transformer的架构，通过掩码建模在大型异构银行事件语料上进行自监督预训练，以适应金融记录离散、长度可变的特性。PRAGMA可支持信用评分、欺诈检测等多种下游任务，为金融领域的人工智能应用提供了基础能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.08649v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modern financial systems generate vast quantities of transactional and event-level data that encode rich economic signals. This paper presents PRAGMA, a family of foundation models for banking event sequences. Our approach pre-trains a Transformer-based architecture with masked modelling on a large-scale, heterogeneous banking event corpus using a self-supervised objective tailored to the discrete, variable-length nature of financial records. The resulting model supports a wide range of downstream tasks such as credit scoring, fraud detection…
items.why_zh: 该研究将基础模型范式引入金融事件建模，有望提升银行风控与金融服务智能化水平。
items.why_en: This work brings foundation models to financial event sequences, potentially improving risk control and intelligent financial services.

items.title_zh: GraphSVR：图卷积支持向量回归框架用于鲁棒的城市空气污染时空预测
items.title_en: GraphSVR: A Graph Convolutional Support Vector Regression Framework for Robust Spatiotemporal Air Pollution Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 城市空气质量预测面临污染物浓度非线性、非平稳、时空依赖以及交通拥堵、工业排放和季节性气象变化导致的异常观测等挑战。该研究提出GraphSVR框架，结合图卷积学习捕捉监测站点间的空间依赖关系，并采用支持向量回归进行鲁棒的时空预测。通过这种组合，模型能够有效抑制异常观测的干扰，提高预测稳定性。该框架有望提升城市空气污染预警的准确性，为环境治理提供技术支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.03795v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Urban air quality forecasting is challenging because pollutant concentrations are nonlinear, nonstationary, spatiotemporally dependent, and often affected by anomalous observations caused by traffic congestion, industrial emissions, and seasonal meteorological variability. This study proposes a Graph Convolutional Support Vector Regression (GraphSVR) framework for robust spatiotemporal forecasting of urban air pollution. The model combines graph convolutional learning to capture inter-station spatial dependence with support vector regression…
items.why_zh: 该框架提供了一种更稳健的空气污染预测手段，有助于提升城市环境监测与预警能力。
items.why_en: This framework offers a more robust method for air pollution forecasting, helping to improve urban environmental monitoring and early warning.

items.title_zh: 低资源场景下的最优传输手写文本识别
items.title_en: Optimal Transport for Handwritten Text Recognition in a Low-Resource Regime
items.summary_zh: 手写文本识别是文档图像理解中的核心任务。现有最先进方法需要大量标注数据，难以适应历史档案或小型现代数据集等低资源场景。该论文提出一种新框架，区别于标准HTR范式，利用词汇特征的温和先验知识，适用于标注数据稀缺的情况。该框架基于最优传输理论，通过迭代方式优化，从而在低资源条件下实现有效的手写文本识别。此项研究有望降低手写文档数字化的数据门槛。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2509.16977v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) is a task of central importance in the field of document image understanding. State-of-the-art methods for HTR require the use of extensive annotated sets for training, making them impractical for low-resource domains like historical archives or limited-size modern collections. This paper introduces a novel framework that, unlike the standard HTR model paradigm, can leverage mild prior knowledge of lexical characteristics; this is ideal for scenarios where labeled data are scarce. We propose an iterati…
items.why_zh: 该研究为低资源手写文本识别提供了新思路，有助于推动历史文档和稀有语料的数字化进程。
items.why_en: This research offers a new approach to low-resource HTR, facilitating digitization of historical archives and rare collections.

items.title_zh: 罕见参数更新的线性上下文Bandit：实用且最优的算法
items.title_en: Practical and Optimal Algorithm for Linear Contextual Bandits with Rare Parameter Updates
items.summary_zh: 该研究探讨线性上下文Bandit问题中参数更新频率受限的场景：学习器只能在少量更新时刻利用奖励反馈更新参数，但同时在线观察上下文并顺序选择动作。这与文献中常见的“严格批处理”方法不同，后者还限制了区间内的上下文适应性。研究者提出了实用且最优的算法，在保持计算效率的同时实现了理论上的最优性。这一工作为现实世界中更新成本高昂的在线决策问题提供了解决方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.00984v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study linear contextual bandits under rare parameter updates: the learner may incorporate reward feedback into its parameter estimate only at a small number of update times, while still observing contexts online and selecting actions sequentially. This viewpoint clarifies a practical distinction that is often blurred in the literature: many "strictly batched" methods additionally restrict within-interval context adaptivity, meaning that the action rule inside an interval cannot depend on the sequence of realized contexts/actions in t…
items.why_zh: 该算法为参数更新受限的在线决策场景提供了理论最优且实用的方法，具有广泛应用价值。
items.why_en: This algorithm provides a theoretically optimal and practical solution for online decision-making with infrequent parameter updates.

items.title_zh: FlatVPR：一种即插即用的地理线性残差适配器，用于基础模型特征流形的几何校正
items.title_en: FlatVPR: Plug-and-play Geo-linear Residual Adapter for Geometric Rectification of Foundation Model Feature Manifolds
items.summary_zh: 视觉位置识别需要在轻量地图与定位精度之间权衡。该论文提出FlatVPR，一种新颖的几何校正范式，通过强制特征流形结构，使相邻锚点间的任意描述子都能通过线性插值精确重构，从而化解这一矛盾。该适配器可即插即用地应用于现有基础模型，实现在不增加地图负担的同时提升定位准确性。该方法有望用于大规模视觉定位和自动驾驶等场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.01734v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper proposes ``FlatVPR,'' a novel geometric rectification paradigm that effectively bridges the trade-off between map lightweightness and localization accuracy in visual place recognition (VPR) by enforcing a feature manifold structure where any descriptor between two adjacent anchors $\mathbf{z}_A$ and $\mathbf{z}_B$ can be accurately reconstructed via linear interpolation $\hat{\mathbf{z}}_{pseudo} = (1-t)\mathbf{z}_A + t\mathbf{z}_B$, where $t \in [0,1]$ denotes the relative position. While state-of-the-art foundation models s…
items.why_zh: 该工作通过轻量适配器解决了VPR中地图轻量化和定位精度之间的矛盾，具有实用价值。
items.why_en: This work resolves the trade-off between map lightweightness and localization accuracy in VPR with a plug-and-play adapter.
